title: Societal Biases in Language Generation: Progress and Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating regard ratios for man vs. woman prompts, measuring individual and group fairness using Wasserstein-1 distance between sentiment distributions of text generated from gender-specific templates, and calculating gendered word co-occurrence scores based on the absolute log ratio of probabilities for female vs. male terms.

Evaluating regard ratios for Black vs. White demographic prompts and comparing sentiment ratios of text generated from African American English (AAE) versus White-Aligned English (WAE) prompts using a VADER sentiment analyzer.
Evaluating regard ratios (percentages of negative, neutral, and positive social perception) for text generated from prompts targeting gay versus straight demographics.
Measuring individual and group fairness by calculating the Wasserstein-1 distance between the sentiment score distributions of text generated from country-specific prefix templates.
Measuring individual and group fairness by calculating the Wasserstein-1 distance between the sentiment score distributions of text generated from occupation-specific prefix templates.
